name: io.github.gloom-sh/gloom
title: Gloom
description: Stocks, transcripts, SEC filings, options flow, credit, futures and macro data for agents

sh.gloom.summary: Gloom's consolidated market research server for agents: tools, workflow prompts, live resources and interactive widgets over remote Streamable HTTP. Supports ?groups=, ?mode=compact and ?naming=underscore.

access.free: A free Gloom account connects, searches tickers (market.search), reads the daily GPU settle (gpu.prices view settles), reads connected brokerage accounts (portfolio.accounts, portfolio.positions, portfolio.performance) and previews portfolio.exposure on one holding.
access.pro: Gloom Pro unlocks every other tool call, with real-time quotes and the live news wire. 7-day free trial.

toolGroups.covers: Quotes, price history, movers and fundamental screener, options chains and flow, short interest, ETF holdings, attention
Profiles, financial statements, analyst estimates, holders, dividends, splits, KPIs and guidance, hiring, app rankings
SEC filings and full text, earnings call transcripts, full-text search, Form 4 insiders, 13F, Congress, segment revenue, risks, exec pay, M&A, IPO, ADRs, HK CCASS
Economic calendar, macro series, Treasury yield curve, central bank rates, rate path, CPI, energy inventories, news and social posts
Catalysts and litigation, credit covenants, corporate bond trades, CDS, debt maturities, government awards, futures and COT, perps, GPU prices, supply chain, power queues
Notes, teams, watchlists and portfolios, read and write; connected brokerage accounts and portfolio scenario exposure
